title: Toddler Girl in Dress at Park Pavilion, 1959 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white 1959 square snapshot with scalloped edges featuring a young girl wearing a frilly white dress. She stands in a grassy park setting in front of a wooden shelter with picnic tables in the background. The photo is date stamped OCT 59 along the right border and has blue ink writing at the top margin, capturing a candid glimpse into mid-century American family life.
